With a second chance at life, she gets engaged to Prince Elliot and it seems like she'll finally get her happy ever after... But then her marriage is called off AGAIN?! It seems Elliot wasn't after love, but the extraordinary ability that ran in her family for generations! But Cierra showed no signs of inheriting it... "If you don't have that power, you are worthless to me!" And with that, Elliot abandons her with his new fiancee in arms. Cierra falls to ground sobbing in despair and heartbreak at her second failed engagement when a blurry vision of Elliot appears through her tears... The night that my crush's younger brother found out who I like, I found myself in bed with none other than...?

"Yuki" for lunch, "Yuuki" for dinner. The two look and sound the same, yet have completely different personalities inside-one is gentle and calm, and the other is a hotheaded bully. Aoi Manamiya, a university student who spends most of his time studying and working part-time at a cafe, has a crush on Yuki Asakura, a caring coworker and good cook to boot. Aoi, whose feelings grow as Yuki comes over every day to feed him, acts callous towards him in an effort to hide his feelings. No matter how nice Yuki is to me, he's still a man...or so Aoi tells himself. In the meantime, Yuki's younger brother, Yuuki, easily sees through the love Aoi had tried so hard to hide. He was especially curious about the Serpent God's lower body. "Snakes have two of those, don't they? ...Wouldn't it be huge in snake form?!" he couldn't help but wonder. However, when their wedding night finally arrived... nothing happened?! It turned out the Serpent God was hiding a secret. Despite his tough and fearsome exterior, he yearned to experience pure, romantic love, not just the pleasures of the flesh! Pure romantic longing vs. an uncontrollable lower half?! Ryou Fudou is a loner because his face looks far too intimidating. One day, he is about to be hit by a truck when Tsukimino-san saves him. Wanting to thank her, Ryou-kun chases after Tsukimino-san, but ends up stumbling straight into a confession scene, where he gets asked, "Would you love me even if I were a demon?" Tsukimino-san casts a spell of amnesia, but for some reason Ryou-kun seems to have a constitution that repels magic, and the spell bounces right off him. Panicking, she then casts a subjugation spell to make him her "pet," but that too is repelled. 211088.description:
Every kingdom must always be wary of its enemies and never let its guard down. This was a lesson Eldior’s father failed to learn: the prince was caught off guard by an invasion of his kingdom, forcing his father to help him flee as quickly as possible to seek aid from an allied nation. The way he managed to go unnoticed was by dressing as a woman: after all, they were looking for a prince. During his escape, he ends up receiving help from a group of warriors through a favorable agreement.

During their journey, they uncover the motivations behind the invasion of Eldior’s kingdom — there is more to it than just the plundering of treasures and lands. The group faces an enemy much closer than they imagine, with grave consequences.

(Source: Mythos, translated)

211092.description:
Tokiwa lives a comfortable, quiet life in a sleepy seaside town, thinking his peaceful days will go on forever. But, on his 18th birthday, his parents hit him with shocking news: the whole family is moving abroad, and Tokiwa has no say in the matter. He storms out in a rage and runs into Akiyoshi, a handsome young man he often exchanges greetings with on the way to school. Hearing about Tokiwa's plight, Akiyoshi suggests Tokiwa stay with him as a live-in housekeeper. It seems almost too good to be true. Why is Akiyoshi so kind to him? And, why does it feel like they share a deeper bond than Tokiwa can remember?

Thus begins a tale of love spanning a thousand years...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: In This Life Or The Next, I Will Always Love You

이 결혼 괜찮을까요?

211094.description:
“An office romance where you find yourself hopelessly entangled with the exact type of junior colleague you hate”

Han Song-I, who, despite her outstanding work performance, constantly has her credit stolen by a clique within her team. But another source of stress arises for her. Kim Ji-Hun, a hopelessly unprofessional rookie who’s been a thorn in her side since his first day on the job. When Ji-Hun moves into Song-I’s neighborhood, the two start running into each other more often. In the process, Ji-Hun helps Song-I get rid of her clingy ex-boyfriend and even takes down a man she considered her sworn enemy. As a result, Song-I begins to develop a personal fondness for Ji-Hun…

Is romance even possible with a junior colleague who’s as stubborn as a dog—biting when provoked and turning fierce when you try to protect her?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 개 같은 후배님

211095.description:
“Let’s do it while we’re at it, you and me!”

She sucked the “XX” out of “XX Friend.

Lee Ah-Young, “universally acknowledged as a beauty,” thought her life would be smooth sailing. But perhaps being too beautiful was a curse. For the past 10 years, she’s been living with a diminished sex drive, suffering from a fatal trauma caused by dating the wrong man. She had planned to just pick a rich guy and settle down, but under the influence of alcohol, she crossed a line she shouldn’t have with her male best friend of ten years, Jeong Hyun-Wook.

But something’s strange. My friend Hyun-Wook is a lifelong single wizard—did he really cast a spell? I just can’t forget that one night. I’m going crazy thinking about his private parts over and over again.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

title.native: 물고 빠는 사이

211096.description:
Yeo-Eul despises thugs and womanizers, but her next-door neighbor, Un-Gyeol, seems to be both. Plagued by excess yin energy that attracts dangerous spirits, Un-Gyeol needs a woman's yang energy to save him. Realizing Yeo-Eul is the one who can solve his supernatural problem, he initiates a passionate physical relationship. While Yeo-Eul tries to keep their relationship casual, fearing he is a deceitful, rotten playboy, Un-Gyeol grows deeply, obsessively devoted. Is this fling bound for a friendly ending? Or will Un-Gyeol not allow it to end at all?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

211097.description:
Rudbeckia has loved Arenfried for a long time and becomes his wife, only to find herself trapped in a cold, loveless marriage. Desperate for his affection, she slips a questionable "love potion" in his drink, but quickly gets caught. Following a disastrous misunderstanding, Rudbeckia panics and downs the potion herself, which leads to a series of feverish nights that change her relationship with Arenfried forever. Will this heated mistake be the key to saving their rocky marriage?

(Source: Tappytoon)

211099.description:
“I don't need your help, so get lost, you bastard.”

Jelim, who had suffered another defeat in his second-ever Champions League final, was once again embroiled in rumors of a rift after rudely brushing off Aaron, the opposing team's striker and his former youth teammate, who had reached out to him. Since they really didn’t get along, it was more accurate to say they were actually at odds rather than just rumors of a rift. Anyway, since they were in different leagues, I didn’t give it a second thought.

“Let’s do better from now on, Jelim.”

That is, until a month later, when Aaron decided to join the same club as me. It’s shitty enough just to be on the same team as the guy who just screwed me over in the last final, but on top of that, he’s my ex-boyfriend from way back when. And we broke up in the worst possible way.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

211100.description:
Homurako Yoshii, a country girl born and raised, transfers into an elite girls' school in the heart of Tokyo. There, she meets Sasara Takamura, admired by those around her for her brains and her beauty... but she's actually a he?! The two of them, polar opposites in both status and personality, are drawn to each other....

(Source: MangaPlaza)

211101.description:
I got totally wasted at a party and ended up spewing my guts... and some hot guy saw me?! I ran away, thinking I'd never see him again, but we ran into each other on campus the next day! He may be good-looking, but he spilled the beans about me throwing up to his friend, and on top of that, he keeps calling me by my first name! He's seriously the worst! Despite all of that, my best friend Yuka is head over heels for him, and now she wants me to help hook her up! She even brought his friend into this mess... What will happen in this 4-way love affair...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: It originally ran from 2013 to 2016, with 31 chapters and 3 volumes. A two-volume new edition was released in 2021, with 4 new chapters.

211102.description:
After giving up Taekwondo for over 10 years, Sohee, who lives like a hanryang, has only one interest... k-teen romance! I dream of a future where I will become a lover with 'Soo-hyeon', who is going well. but… One day, So-hee's cell phone syncs a photo that is presumed to be the future, and the boy who became her lover in the photo... It was Lee An-do, an unlucky classmate! can not believe it! There is no probability in this love affair! Even after that, So-hee is confused by the more and more pictures of the future... Will it flow according to the spoiled ending?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

211105.description:
In the midst of a crowded ballroom, the Countess Sherazade is overcome by a flood of memories. Memories of a past life as an ordinary girl in another world, reading a Teen Love novel about a meek, but kind-hearted young woman from an impoverished noble family who catches the Prince's eye, and then attracts his love. A novel that recounts the story of her own life... or what it will soon become.

The only problem is... this story ends with Sherazade as a traumatized and broken shell of herself, and there's no way she's going to sit back and let that happen. At that moment, Shera makes a promise to herself— to do whatever it takes to make sure she will never, ever marry the prince!

(Source: Tokyopop)

Ryu Dan-woo, an ordinary college student, gets "chosen" (?) by a young demon he meets on the street. The demon follows him into his apartment without permission and settles in, and from that day on, Dan-woo's once-ordinary life goes completely awry. In order to return to his normal life, he begins searching for clues to dimensional magic together with his college classmate Siduk and the witch Jueun…

Lavinia is a villainous queen in a novel who is murdered by someone she trusts. When the reader wakes up as Lavinia, she knows there are five murder suspects: her seemingly loyal knight, her sly chancellor, her spy who was formerly an assassin, a brutal tribal king, and her brother, who's also her political rival. These men are all fixated on her, but when Lavinia changes her tyrannic ways, their obsession becomes less hostile and more friendly... even romantic, for some! Ju-Gyeong is a powerhouse Chief Producer who has never felt a single spark of true love. But her life shatters when a rogue celestial’s forbidden arrow strikes her by mistake. Consumed by a supernatural fever, she stumbles into the arms of Hyeon-U. One look at him is all it takes for the curse to ignite, forcing a desperate confession to a total stranger. Now, Ju-Gyeong must navigate a cutthroat industry and a vengeful executive director. In a world where a cold heart leads to a cold grave, can she turn a forced obsession into a love worth living for?

211137.description:
Lee Sam-Tak, 28 and single, quit his job and moved back to his hometown to become a farmer, where he bought some farmland. He then had business cards printed with “Farmer” as his occupation and handed them out to everyone he met. He was worried that the neighbors, curious about his move to the countryside, might bombard him with annoying questions or gossip.

Lee Sam-Tak handed out those business cards. And once he did, the word “farmer” printed on those cards became the name the locals used to address him. That’s right—it became his proper name. Even if Lee Sam-Tak is clumsy at farming and ruins the crops, people still call him “Farmer”—as if mocking him. Even when Lee Sam-Tak runs around the mountains day in and day out with a shotgun, claiming he’s hunting animals that harm the crops, people still call him “Farmer.”

No, no. What if—just what if—for real! Let’s say Lee Sam-Tak says he’s “just taking a break.” Even then, they’d still call him “Farmer.” Those villagers would. Because that’s what Lee Sam-Tak wants.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

211138.description:
You know the drill: A miserable woman is offered a do-over and finds herself magically back in time. However, for Titiana, her second life isn't a hit, either... After ending up a widow in her first life and a divorcée in her second, she's rather doubtful of the mysterious mage who reversed the clock for her, but he convinces her to give it one more shot. This time, determined to stand on her own two feet, she'll open a flower shop and stick to her plan! Can Titiana break her streak of bad luck?

(Source: Tapas)

To maintain public order among the remaining humans, “anthropomorphized” versions of various traffic signs and safety devices were created, and they go about their daily routines in this world...

After abolishing the death penalty, the Lunaris exiled its worst criminals to a savage, lawless island, where there are no rules, no rescue, no way out. Framed and stripped of her status, noble heiress He Bufan is cast into this living hell, becoming the first woman ever sent to the island. When outnumbered, outmatched, and surrounded by twenty of the most brutal killers alive, can she survive... or find a way to escape?

Reunited with a childhood friend after five years, I was in my first year of high school, yet you stood before me, a teacher.... Kato is a young man with a peculiar condition that causes him to age three years for every year of real time. Orihara watches over him as both a friend and a student. This is the tale of the unusual life of these two former classmates.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 桜は君に3度舞う

211146.description:
Alice, a daughter of a duke, was accused of a crime she never committed and put into female prison. She swore revenge to those who framed her. Alice becomes boss of villainesses in the prison, and forms a team for revenge!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

211147.description:
Nanami dreams of falling in love with a prince... And she's 29. She finds fulfillment in love through fantasizing about Yuhi, her favorite character from a love simulation game. One day, while out at a pub with her friends from work, she meets Minato -- a college student who is the spitting image of Yuhi... but then Minato calls Nanami a middle-aged hag. "What a shame, with that personality your stunning visuals amount to nothing. I know -- I'll fix that worthless personality of his and get him to cosplay as Yuhi!"Thus begins Nanami's plan to turn Minato into a prince! A romantic comedy featuring a pair mismatched in both age and personality. Your heart is sure to pound out of your chest!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm Starting to Fall in Love With the Prince

211148.description:
A boyfriend whose love is so strong it becomes smothering - "Sena, look only at me." - an impudently wicked underclassman - "You should just break up with that boyfriend of yours." - and the girl wavering between them on a seesaw of love! Since Sena struggles to speak her mind, her boyfriend Minoru worries and has been taking extra care to watch over her. Then one day, Sena decides to attend her school club's drinking party after Hayato, an underclassman in the same club, asks for her help.She's always turned down the parties before to avoid worrying Minoru, and the moment she tells him she's going to one, his whole demeanor suddenly changes... While she's tossed about like a ship in a storm, which man will Sena choose in the end...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

211149.description:
Due to her tall stature and red hair, Layla Shormet has been called "Candle Girl" ever since she can remember. It's no wonder she's insecure about her looks. After finding her fiancé being intimate with another woman at a party and then being ridiculed by him in front of everybody there, she calls their engagement off. In fact, she decides she's done with marriage once and for all and that she'll just be a knight for the rest of her life! So, when she hears about an assignment where she must accompany the princess to another country where the king is looking for his queen, she accepts it. But, little does she know what's in store for her there...!

(Source: Renta!)

211153.description:
Isaac von Goethe’s uncontrollable mana explosions have harmed everyone around him, forcing him into 60 years of isolation. 211327.description:
“Hey, do you know me?”

“How the hell would I know you?”

A tall, pretty-faced guy who’d just appeared in front of Do Geon-U, a man who’d led a rough life, suddenly started hitting on him right to his face. As he lay there, overwhelmed by this persistent guy who’d followed him all the way to a hotel room, the face of that kid, whose lips had drooped like a rain-soaked puppy under the streetlights in early summer, overlapped with his own.

“Why are you having sex with some other guy after drinking the booze I bought you?”

Only then did Do Geon-U realize it. He had lived his life forgetting that he had been that kid’s first love back when he was young—that little midge flitting around the orange glow that night.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

National actor Cha Kang-Hyun leads a life that’s a complete mess, despite his glamorous public image. To make matters worse, his wife, who is on the verge of divorcing him, threatens to expose his affair to the world. Facing this crisis, Kang-Hyun eventually accepts an offer of financial support from Seo Yu-Jun, the CEO of TM Entertainment…

“I’ll give you a break now, so go ahead and vent here as much as you want. I like vulgar guys.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Han Tae-Yang was out on a rare vacation, enjoying a drink, when he received a message from his junior colleague, who was also on leave. He’d been dumped by his girlfriend. At those words, Han Tae-Yang rushed over to where his junior, Cha U-Jin, was without a moment’s hesitation. He didn’t know it then. He had no idea that this junior would be the first to take advantage of him.

"Sorry, Tricia, but I need you to leave this party." Tricia, a healer, is kicked out of a party of one man and two women when everyone else forms a couple. As compensation, she receives a deposit from the party and plans to start a rental business for adventurers.

Together with her longtime S-rank adventurer friend Luke, she uses her secret skill [Reset] to aim for "passive income," a dream she's had since her previous life—a laid-back rental business fantasy!

Lee Jeong-Yeon lost everything the day his lover died saving a stranger. A stranger none other than, Ki Seo-Hyeok, the boy Jeong-Yeon once taught. Drowning in grief and haunted by the unfairness of his loss, Jeong-Yeon seeks out the Seo-Hyeok, driven by a desperate need to see the life that was bought with his lover's blood. But as Seo-Hyeok begins to fill the empty spaces in Jeong-Yeon's life, the mourning teacher realizes that some debts are paid in ways more dangerous than death.

Miwa Iida has lived her life with full confidence in two things- cute looks and a good façade. As a new hire right out of university, she's now on the hunt to dig up information on people and have some more fun in this new chapter of her life. However, it looks like the real world won't let that happen so easily. Now Miwa's on a mission to push her work aside, and make some plans after some difficult people get in the way...!

Cute? Pure? Shirayuki, or "Snow White" has the eye of every man in the office. With her "Seven Dwarfs" supporting her, Shirayuki can get away with just about anything in the office. 211350.description:
"Are you still playing that game...?" Harumi juggles housework and caring for her 8-month-old daughter, Miyu, while her husband, Takashi, spends all his free time glued to his games. Insensitive to Harumi's struggles, he brushes off her concerns. "You're sick? Don't give it to me. I have to go to work, you know." When Takashi prioritizes his game over her declining health, Harumi reaches her breaking point. Though he loves their daughter, he remains oblivious to the effort it takes to raise her. Frustrated and with nowhere else to turn, Harumi confides in a friend, who recommends a "legendary babysitter" with a reputation for solving even the most complicated problems mothers face. On a whim, Harumi hires him, only to be completely taken aback when he arrives. He's nothing like what she imagined.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

"I just want to beat Myung-ho once."

Song Baram, who has wandered in the shadows overshadowed by the star of a famous gym, Myung-ho, finally gets the chance to compete against him, a match he has long yearned for. After a relentless struggle, Song Baram achieves a miraculous victory, but Myung-ho is left unable to open his eyes again.

Following this unfortunate incident, Song Baram quits boxing and returns to his hometown of Yongmun, where he fights to protect the only thing left to him: the 'Rose Gym'...

(Source: Naver, translated)

211353.description:
Simon Harper is a psychometry detective who can witness the moment of death by touching a corpse, but only through direct contact with the body itself. This peculiar method earns him a reputation as an eccentric, and work eventually dries up entirely. Resigned to giving up detective work and living an ordinary life, he one day receives a strange phone call: "My father is definitely dead, and yet he's still alive." Following this mysterious call, Simon accidentally touches the hand of a body brought into a hospital, only to realize it belongs to Frank Ferreira, the very much living president of a pharmaceutical company. From that moment on, a relentless series of bizarre incidents begins closing in around him…

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 바디셰이드

211354.description:
Asuka had always dreamed of a romantic proposal, but when the time came, all she got from her live-in boyfriend of seven years, Yuta, was a casual "How about we get married?" over dinner at their local bar. He didn't even put down his phone or look her in the eyes! She goes off on him (in her mind) but then reminds herself to be realistic and accepts his proposal. As the wedding approaches, she finds an open box of condoms while cleaning one day... and notices that only one is left, even though she can't remember using any of them with Yuta. That's all the proof she needs: the bastard is cheating on her!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

As their intimate sessions continue, Woohyun’s feelings for Daon grow significantly. Their pleasurable encounters, filled with deep connections and intense moments, blur the lines between carnal enjoyment and something more. What started as a quest for a memorable experience becomes a journey of unexpected emotions…

Ha-Ji, who tutored students as a side job, ends up tutoring Il-Do, a wealthy student retaking the college entrance exam. One day, she receives shocking news from her younger sister.

“Sis, did you know... Il-Do is actually a junior of mine at university?”

It turns out that Il-Do, whom she thought was a student retaking the college entrance exam, is actually a junior at Korea University who has already been accepted. From the day his true identity is revealed, Il-Do’s meticulous schemes and relentless obsession begin to slowly tighten their grip on Ha-Ji’s life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

211360.description:
"I want this man for myself."

Nails, makeup, hair... Remi, an office worker, doesn't slack off when it comes to investing in herself. The reason she's willing to go this far? To snag a man who's worthy of her, of course. One day, her childhood friend, Yumi, asks Remi to check out a man that she is interested in and introduces them. Much to her surprise, Takashi is ideal husband material, and the perfect high-caliber man that Remi has been looking for! She immediately decides that she'll make him hers, no matter what. And Takashi doesn't seem too put off by Remi flaunting her good looks his way... What will come of this greedy love affair?! A collection of stories about girls and their lives now that they're all grown up.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

211361.description:
I've been preparing for a competition that could open doors for me as an aspiring artist, but one day, in one fell swoop, I lost my art model and my girlfriend. I was still reeling from it when a young girl suddenly showed up beside me and said she would be my new model. However, now she says I need to offer up my body in exchange for her help...?! I had lost everything, and she knew nothing of the world; this is the story of our warped and fleeting, yet innocent, love.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

211362.description:
In a land long ravaged by war, Minju grows up hearing tales that on certain nights, the spirits of the dead roam and take the living. After discovering that her guardians plan to sell her as a human sacrifice to a river god, she flees into the mountains. Lost in the darkness, she is saved by a mysterious being known as Baekgwi- a white-haired spirit clad in armor.

Baekgwi offers her a grim bargain: if she can find his missing corpse within ten days, he will spare her life. If she fails, he will kill her. As Minju struggles against time to uncover the truth hidden in the mountain, she begins to question the true nature of Baekgwi - whether he is truly a ghost, and what binds him to the world of the living.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Her world is turned upside down one evening when, after a few too many drinks, she catches Ryosuke in a compromising position. This isn't the "Prince" she knows at the office-and Kotori is left questioning everything.

In this world of nobility and societal manners, women of this age unmarried are considered bizarre or outlandish. The family Audrey is a part of, the house of Baron Noland, has been serving the royal family as educators for generations. One day, Audrey's father throws out his back... and provides her with the opportunity to tutor the prince in his stead. Michiru is a front desk clerk at a company for sportswear, and she has one thing that's bothering her. She has been dating her boyfriend, Leo, for 6 months, and they even live together. And yet... they haven't had sex, not even once! Michiru has tried every trick in the book to try and seduce Leo, but it's just been failure after failure... To meet the strict quotas imposed by this campaign, "fixed operations"—in which the police collude with the yakuza—become rampant. Amidst this environment stands a man known as "The Ace": Keisuke Kido. Cultivating a network of criminals as informants, he successfully seizes a volume of firearms far exceeding his assigned quotas. Then, he crosses paths with Sho Yashiki, a high-ranking executive within the Seirinkai syndicate. Aiming to land an even bigger bust, Kido sets his sights on the Kashiwagumi's weapons cache. He enlists Yashiki for an undercover operation; in exchange for Kido turning a blind eye to his drug-smuggling activities, Yashiki agrees to join forces with him. Now, he’s a wealthy, handsome young physician and the easiest target Pilju’s ever seen. But behind Ae-gyeom’s bashful smiles and devoted eyes, something just doesn’t sit right.

Living in a humble, one-room thatched cottage with only his loyal white dog for company, 22-year-old Farmer wrapped up another exhausting day of tilling the fields and settled in for the night.

Thrashing beneath a worn blanket, the young man twists in feverish distress as the ties of his thin undergarments loosen, exposing his bare skin to the cool night air. Dripping with cold sweat and consumed by an inexplicable sensation, he spends night after night tormented in his sleep by an invisible presence.

To understand who—or what—is driving this naive farmer to the edge, one must look back 99 days prior. Who could have guessed that sparing a seemingly helpless earthworm would spiral into a hundred-night ordeal of giving up his vital energy? Just what is this worm plotting?

211963.description:
A world where two unique type of people exist: "Forks" and "Cakes."

Hasegawa—a "fork" who isn't able to taste anything—was sitting in a cafe and picking at his flavorless dessert as usual. That was until Takahashi—a "cake" with a vividly sweet scent—showed up. Drawn in by the sweet scent that he hadn't smelled in years, Hasegawa followed his instincts and spent the night with Takahashi. However, several days later, they discover that they work at the same company. Hasegawa feels shaken by this sudden reunion, but...?

A sweet and tasty cake x fork cakeverse BL♥

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

211969.description:
"Takanashi is more..."
"Yachi is more..."

"You're the one who's creepier!"

Haruki Yachi, the school's prince, is actually a hardcore yuri-loving otaku. Confused by the gap between how others perceive him and his true self, Yachi meets Ayato Takanashi, a frail-looking boy who spends his time in the infirmary, during the winter of his first year of high school, and his otaku identity is revealed. The after-school hours spent chatting in Takanashi's room are the only time he can be his true self. Yachi wants to know more about Takanashi, but...

A story about two awkward yuri-loving closet otaku and an eroge gamer who spends his time in the infirmary, two otaku boys who will eventually become BL!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

211970.description:
When Mienne is ready to play, nothing will get in her way! And being blind is the last thing that's going to stop this cute kitten from playing all day long. Meet Mienne, an adorable kitten with boundless energy who happens to be blind. But nobody can tell this cutie has any trouble seeing with how hard she plays—at least, until she bumps into something. And even then, she just keeps going!

Fall pawsitively in love with this adorable cat in this sweet collection of her daily adventures—with new content never posted online!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Asahi Shimbun for commercial release.

211971.description:
Owari Machida was a professional fisherman who made a name for himself in the media, but his former glory proved short-lived, and he struggles everyday to make ends meet. One day, while out boat fishing, he gets swept away by the waves and fell into the sea, losing consciousness as he downs because of a malfunction of his life jacket. When Owari awakens, the scenery has completely changed—he finds himself in an Isekai... In this world where the culture of fishing has declined, Owari wanders around enjoying fishing with the fishing gear that transmigrated with him, while interacting with the locals...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

A laid-back, heartwarming comedy about an occult research club!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

211989.description:
What kind of marriage is this at eighteen?!

Kim Yong-Man, the Dragon King’s daughter who fled from the Dragon Palace to the human world to escape an arranged marriage, enters high school with the goal of becoming the top student in the school. But Shim Hae-Su, the current top student sitting right next to Yong-Man, doesn’t seem too thrilled about the arrival of a rival...

Why do these two, who are already too busy studying, keep getting tangled up with each other?! A romance (?) about improving grades featuring an 18-year-old boy and girl.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 용한소녀

211990.description:
Han Ji-Tae is a naive twenty-year-old dominant Alpha caught between two possessive men: Ju Kang-U, the older Omega lover who snatched his virginity, and Woo Hyeon-Seung, the devoted Beta bodyguard who spent eight years watching over him before falling blindly in love. Hyeon-Seung despises Kang-U’s bad influence, Kang-U hates Hyeon-Seung’s interference, and both have secretly claimed Ji-Tae's body in a frenzy of jealousy. But Ji-Tae isn't planning on choosing between them. Now, two shameless men find themselves forced into a tangled, three-way dynamic where sharing is the only option.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 버릇없는 놈들

211991.description:
An ER romance between resident Da-Jeong and hospital CEO Tae-Kyung!

Da-Jeong, a pediatrician, spends an impulsive one-night stand with Tae-Kyung, the newly appointed CEO of the hospital foundation.

“I’m sorry, CEO. Please just forget about it—”

“I don’t think that’s going to work. I have an absolutely phenomenal memory.”

Tae-Kyung, nicknamed “The Bloodthirsty Butcher” for his foul temper and brutality, takes office as the new CEO, and the department, already struggling with deficits, feels threatened. Da-Jeong, who works in the Pediatrics Department, one of the hospital’s three deficit-ridden departments, is both afraid of Tae-Kyung and can’t stop thinking about him. CEO Tae-Kyung clearly came to shut down the Pediatrics Department, so why is Da-Jeong falling for him so helplessly?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 응급 플러팅

211992.description:
“I've been seeing ghosts since I was a kid. And only male ghosts, at that.”

Young Jae-Yeong has a secret. It’s that he enjoys reading BL manga with his “ghost brothers.” When his father finds out, Jae-Yeong is forced to leave his neighborhood and begins attending shamanistic rituals. Eventually, he succeeds in making the ghosts disappear, but due to repeated school transfers and spiritual rituals, Jae-Yeong becomes physically and emotionally exhausted, feeling empty inside. When Jae-Yeong returns to his neighborhood, he is greeted by Do-Ha. Do-Ha, who used to be a timid younger brother who cried at the drop of a hat, had grown tall enough to look down on Jae-Yeong. But the joy is short-lived, as Do-Ha begins to gradually disrupt Jae-Yeong’s daily life.

“Hyung, my feelings for you… have never faded.”

Do-Ha keeps bringing back memories of a past Jae-Yeong had tried to forget. Is Do-Ha Jae-Yeong’s salvation, or his trial?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The eleventh story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.
